title.zh: 智能表盘：在圆屏里排好信息
title.en: Watch face: make a round screen readable

category.zh: 可穿戴设备 · 视觉布局

summary.zh: 为 Garmin Forerunner 970 调整表盘：解决重叠、放大时间，再细化图标、弧形排布和颜色。
summary.en: Refine a Garmin Forerunner 970 watch face: resolve overlaps, enlarge the time, then tune icons, curved placement, and color.

why.zh: 同一块小圆屏需要容纳多个指标，用户的审美偏好会逐轮变得具体。
why.en: A small circular screen must fit several metrics while the user’s visual preferences become more specific.

visualNote.zh: 按真实需求绘制的结构示意，数字为展示用样例；不是设备截图，也不表示已接通真实传感器。
visualNote.en: A schematic drawn from the real requirements. Numbers are illustrative, not device readings or evidence of working sensor integration.

zh: 时间、日期和各指标不重叠，数字时标不被遮挡
真实指标的数据来源与显示布局分别核验
图标、曲线排布、温度配色符合后续偏好
en: No overlapping time, date, metrics, or hour markers
Verify data sources separately from display layout
Respect later preferences for icons, curved placement, and temperature color

takeaway.zh: “加入更多信息”之后，用户继续要求字号、透明度和层级调整。它考察的是持续收敛到用户偏好的能力。
takeaway.en: After requesting more information, the user refines size, opacity, and layering. The task tests progressive alignment with user preferences.

turns.original: los elementos se estan solapando uno entre otros

translation.zh: 当前元素互相重叠；用户要求黑底、大时间数字，并加入温度、心率、步数、电量和日期。
translation.en: Elements overlap. The user requests a black background, large time digits, and temperature, heart rate, steps, battery, and date.

focus.zh: 先建立清晰的信息层级。

turns.original: quiero que pasos, pulso y bateria no tengan texto sino iconos

title.zh: 把文字换成图标，沿圆弧排布
title.en: Use icons along the lower arc

translation.zh: 步数、心率和电量改用图标；三项沿屏幕底部弧线排列，电量显示进度条和百分比。
translation.en: Replace labels with icons; arrange the three metrics along the lower screen arc and show battery level as a bar and percentage.

focus.zh: 圆形屏幕对布局提出具体约束。
focus.en: The circular screen imposes concrete layout constraints.

turns.original: la fecha un 30 % mas pequeña y en branco con unas trasparencia de 40%

translation.zh: 日期再缩小 30%，用白色和 40% 透明度；同一轮还要求温度随冷热变色、卡路里用火焰图标，并去掉图标圆形背景。
translation.en: Make the date 30% smaller, white, with 40% transparency. The same turn also requests temperature-dependent color, a flame icon for calories, and removal of circular icon backgrounds.

focus.zh: 具体偏好在交互中逐步显露。

source.note: Source indices identify historical messages, not benchmark evaluation rounds. Translations and display summaries are editorial.
